title: Sampling Distributions as Regularization in Learned Inverse Problems
summary: Neural networks have emerged as effective tools for solving ill-posed inverse problems. In many scientific applications, however, observational training data are insufficient, and learned inverse operators must instead be trained on synthetic data generated from the forward model. This requires specifying unknown parameters in the forward model and solving the model to generate synthetic observations.
